name: transcription factor 3

function.text: TCF3 encodes transcription factor E2-alpha. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal agammaglobulinemia (semidominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Burkitt lymphoma; B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: TCF3 encodes transcription factor E2-alpha. Based in part on similarity, heterodimers between TCF3 and tissue-specific basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) proteins play major roles in determining tissue-specific cell fate during embryogenesis, like muscle or early B-cell differentiation. It binds to the kappa-E2 site in the kappa immunoglobulin gene enhancer.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal agammaglobulinemia (semidominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TCF3 have been reported in Burkitt lymphoma and b-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.
